_comment: Copy this file to movie_gdrive_map.json and fill in your own Drive file IDs.
movie_gdrive_map.json is gitignored and must never be committed - it holds
private Drive file IDs. For GitHub Actions, base64 this file and store it
as the GDRIVE_MAP_B64 repository secret; the workflow decodes it at runtime.
Set the ALLOW_PRIVATE_MEDIA_SOURCES repository secret to 'true', otherwise
Drive sourcing stays disabled and the pipeline falls back to trailers.
file_id       : the Google Drive file ID (the d= parameter in the share URL)
file_name     : local cache filename; keep the extension so ffmpeg probes it
timeline_start: optional HH:MM:SS window into the raw movie for this part
timeline_end  : optional HH:MM:SS window end; defaults to the catalog value
